# Purpose
This generated header defines the metric metadata for the `pack` subsystem. It maps each metric name to a fixed offset, type, description, converter, and value range, so the runtime can store and read metric values in a stable layout. The file groups metrics into histograms, counters, and gauges that track transaction intake, scheduling results, block packing state, compute unit use, and delete activity.
